hiveSql:
SELECT
                                       '${end_date}' as d_report_date,
                                       prd_code as c_port_code,
                                       '${tablename}' as c_chapter_name,
                                       xbrl_elem as c_element_name,
                                       case p_dt
                                         when '${end_date}' then '本期'
                                         when (cast(substr('${end_date}',1,4) as int) -1) || '0630' then '上年度末'
                                       end as c_element_type,
                                       xbrl_rn as n_order,
                                       xbrl_val as c_value,
                                       'xbrl_endy_ret_result_pre' as task_rs_id,
                                       current_timestamp as dm_created_time,
                                       '${tablename}' as dm_src_info,
                                       p_dt
                                     FROM ${srcdbname}.${tablename}
                                     WHERE p_dt in(${end_date}, (cast(substr(${end_date},1,4) as int) -1)||'0630')

preSql: delete from xbrl_endy_ret_result_pre where d_report_date = '${end_date}' and c_chapter_name = '${tablename}'
